seed_policy: No provider seed; preserve three independently requested generations per case without selection.
changed_factors: Diagnostic after four cleaned prompt candidates failed under target thinking=false/max_tokens=100. Use the repository v1/settings.json target thinking=true/max_tokens=8000 configuration, preserving r3 model, temperatures, three repetitions, repair/retry policy, concurrency, cases and v1.1 scoring. Acceptance requires a newly matched baseline and full semantic/holdout validation under these settings.
